newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Costello says good inflation flows to rate climate.
newsitem.headline: Costello says good inflation flows to rate climate.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday that a good inflation performance will lead to a good interest rate climate.
Asked at a media briefing about the prospect for another fall in interest rates after Tuesday's "living wage" decision, Costello said he did not speculate on interest rates.
"Interest rates in this country are being managed in accordance with our inflation objective," he told reporters.
"Our inflation objective is an underlying rate of 2-3 percent and we are now at the bottom of that band," he said.
"What that tells you is that a good inflation performance will lead to a good interest rate climate."
Figures released earlier showed the Australian consumer price index (CPI) rose 0.2 percent in the March quarter for an annual inflation rate of 1.3 percent.
The Treasury's measure of underlying inflation rose 0.4 percent in the March quarter to stand at 2.1 percent for the year.
